text_block_list.text:
To help Sweep Tosho, who hasn't been feeling well lately, change her mood,
I stopped by a shrine while we were out.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: What, praying to God now?
choice_data_list: Maybe praying will help clear your mind.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Hmm, is that how it is, I wonder...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: "Well, since we're here, let's pray with all our might!"

While praying for Sweep Tosho's
condition to improve...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Um... please let me get into
great shape...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: And so, I hope I can become a great witch just like Grandma!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: And then, and then, I want to master a spell to guarantee winning races, and a spell to turn Trainer into a more obedient familiar...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: I want that huge plushie I saw in the shopping district the other day, and I want to eat something sweet too!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: And then, and then...
choice_data_list: Aren't you wishing for a bit too much...?
Aren't you wishing for a bit too much...?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
...What? You've got some nerve,
interrupting Master's prayer.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"Oh well, I got to make all my wishes anyway!
With this, I'll become an even more genius magical girl!"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: What are you doing, familiar?! We're going home right now!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, hey familiar, look over there!
Isn't that a cotton candy stall!?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: "To think there'd be food stalls on just an ordinary day... I'm so lucky!"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hey, what are you spacing out for, familiar?!
Hurry up and go buy some cotton candy!
It's on your tab, your tab!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I got to eat sweets right away!
That means my wish came true, right?♪

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
If my wishes keep coming true like this,
I might become a great witch in no time♪

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Hm, hm-hmm~♪

Her wish to eat sweets felt more like sheer brute force than anything,
but thanks to that, Sweep Tosho's condition has improved!
(Caw, caw)

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Wait, what is this?!
Crow poop?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Aren't crows supposed to be a witch's familiar?!
How dare you be so rude to the genius
magical girl Sweepy! What are you thinking?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hey, familiar!!
Hurry up and get a handkerchief wet!
And go buy a change of clothes too!!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Uuuugh, the absolute worst!

Due to a sudden streak of bad luck,
Sweep Tosho's mood plummeted even further...
